bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to adopt analytics and ML capabilities within a compliant framework.
Built a shared-responsibility operating-model framing that clarified insurer-owned versus AWS-owned controls for safe, governed cloud adoption.
Led AWS modernization execution to migrate monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads to a scalable cloud architecture.
